structured.answer: I haven't picked anything. This page is a long dark list of numbers from companies I don't know (מור, אנליסט, מיטב), and nowhere does it say in plain words which option is as safe as a deposit, so I'll ask you or the bank before I move a shekel.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the rows of buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: Too many choices, half of them words I don't know ('s&p 500', 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש', 'כספי (שקלי)'). I didn't know what to press, so I left it on 'הכל'.
I expected a company name there, but it shows numbers like 15286 and 8211. I couldn't tell whose tracks these were. The first company's name never showed up on my screens.
Some rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number. I didn't understand whether that's good or bad.
I don't know these companies. I was looking for my bank or a big name and didn't find one.
I got tired. It was all the same rows with numbers, and I stopped there.

findings.what: There are no company names where I expected them. The 'קופה' column shows numbers, and the company only appears in a thin band row I nearly missed, so it took me a long time to see whose tracks these are.
findings.where: Screens 2–6, 'קופה' column and the group rows (מור, אנליסט, מיטב)

findings.what: It opens with shares, 's&p 500' and index buttons. Nothing says which option is the safe one or how it compares to a deposit.
Dark background and very busy screens full of percentages, with the same layout over and over. It made me anxious and tired by the sixth screen.
An orange warning box says 'נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026'. It worried me that the numbers might be wrong.
Big return numbers like 24.04% and 26.39% sit right next to rows saying 'פחות מ־3 שנים' with no explanation.
I can't tell the coloured rings and the teal and yellow dots apart, and nothing explains what they mean.
Small grey text was hard to read even enlarged: the '123 מקורר / מחושב / הזנתה' line, the column headers and the sort arrows.
Everything is dotted-underlined, so I didn't know what I'm meant to click.
